turns.user_input: Load the weather API response from data/weather_api_response.json and parse it. Give me an overview of its structure — what top-level keys exist and how deeply nested is it?
The forecast array has nested hourly data inside daily data. Extract all hourly temperatures into a flat list with date, hour, and temperature columns.
There are 3 weather alerts buried in the nested structure. Extract them with severity, start time, end time, and description.

Write a reusable Python function that can handle this transformation for any similar weather API response — it should flatten forecast hourly data, extract alerts, and merge historical stats into a single output structure.
Save the flattened hourly forecast data as a CSV-formatted file in the workspace.
